versions.unknownReason.description: Versions: an automatic version was asked for with a reason Flown does not know.

versions.cannotKeep.description: Versions: the edit could not be read as a project, so it is not kept.

versions.tooLarge.description: Versions: the edit is larger than a version may be.

versions.tooMany.description: Versions: Keep a version when the most saved versions (VERSION_LIMITS.named) are already kept; {n} is that number.

versions.gone.description: Versions: the version asked for was deleted (its file is gone).

versions.unreadable.description: Versions: the version's file is damaged or too large.
